name: Amenity's Life
source:
Reiji woke up early in the morning as usual and reached over in bed to check the time on his smartphone. To his surprise, there was a naked girl sleeping next to him instead. She told him that she was his smartphone and he didn’t believe it. His osananajimi Mikuri soon barged in and it took some time to get everything sorted out. Then he realized that the robot vacuum, his headphones and even the kitchen oven had turned into girls. What the hell is going on!?

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2016/12/05/december-2016-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
玲司像往常一樣一大早醒來，伸手拿床上的智慧型手機查看時間。令他驚訝的是，旁邊睡著的竟是一名裸體少女。少女告訴他自己就是他的智慧型手機，但他根本不相信。青梅竹馬的美栗很快闖了進來，花了一番工夫才把事情理清。之後他才發現，掃地機器人、耳機，甚至廚房烤箱都變成了女孩。這到底是怎麼回事！？

[來源：[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2016/12/05/december-2016-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
